test_title: PYST 3: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The given sentence contains an error. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error.

He was carefullest while stealing the crown jewels.

options.text: He was carefully while stealing the crown jewels.
He was most carefuller while stealing the crown jewels.
He was carefuller while stealing the crown jewels.
He was most careful while stealing the crown jewels.

solution:
The correct answer is: He was most careful while stealing the crown jewels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "carefullest" is not a correct superlative form in English.
 
• In English, adjectives with two or more syllables typically form the comparative with **"more"** and the superlative with **"most"**.
 
• Therefore, "careful" should form its superlative as **"most careful"**.
 
• The sentence should use "most careful" to correctly convey the highest degree of carefulness.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *He was most careful while stealing the crown jewels*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"He was carefully while stealing the crown jewels." – This option uses the adverb instead of the superlative form. Hence, the option is incorrect.
 
• **Option 2:** "He was most carefuller while stealing the crown jewels." – This option incorrectly combines both the superlative "most" and the comparative "carefuller", which is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 3: **"He was carefuller while stealing the crown jewels." – This option uses "carefuller" which is not a correct comparative form in English. The correct comparative form is "more careful".
